album_master: every selected source and transform is accounted for
the accepted render is exactly reproducible from a portable score
master_state_rules: frontier_selected requires a sealed owner verdict over a blind frontier
master_qualified requires a deterministic master pair and every signal gate, and is machine evidence only
master_accepted requires an owner verdict naming the mastered PCM itself; no inference from a transparent transform may stand in for that audition
release_eligibility: music acceptance and system completion do not confer rights
publication requires a separate rights decision
system_reference: an inferred candidate blindly beats the declared naive control

title: Album One

tracks.control_question: Does the result read as the supplied Pretty Lights work rather than as a technically related but musically different edit?
tracks.musical_objective: Recover the supplied Pretty Lights remix as a legible, authored arrangement whose phrase structure, recurrence, transitions, source ownership, and production logic survive reconstruction.
tracks.next_gate: Return the strongest existing candidate and controls to an owner review that can accept, revise, or reject the musical result. This lane proves editing, custody and release governance; the retained candidate is an edit of the supplied reference, so it cannot prove performance realization.

lawfully held underlying source or derived material as required by the accepted score

tracks.next_gate: Bind the exact reference recording through container and decoded-audio identity, stopping at edition_candidate if the commission does not name the edition unambiguously. Then build score-to-performance realization and run the cross-modal convergence gate against it.

tracks.next_gate: Bind exact source editions, run the role-based percussion and identity hypotheses, and admit only candidates that beat naive overlap.
